title_original: The Film Comment Podcast: NYFF63 Festival Report
excerpt_original: Signed, sealed, delivered: critics Molly Haskell, J. Hoberman, and Beatrice Loayza join for a spirited wrap-up analysis of the highlights and lowlights from this year's lineup

blocks.text: As the 63rd New York Film Festival drew to a close last weekend, it was once again time for Film Comment ’s Festival Report, our annual live overview of the NYFF that was. FC Editor Clinton Krute was joined by critics Molly Haskell, J. Hoberman, and Beatrice Loayza for a spirited wrap-up analysis of the highlights and lowlights from the NYFF63 lineup. In front of a lively audience, the panel discussed and debated Radu Jude’s Kontinental ’25 , Noah Baumbach’s Jay Kelly , Kelly Reichardt’s The Mastermind , Lav Diaz’s Magellan , Mary Bronstein’s If I Had Legs I’d Kick You , Alexandre Koberidze’s Dry Leaf , and many other selections.
